svg.title: Calculated blackbody spectra at three temperatures
svg.desc: Planck-law spectral exitance versus wavelength from zero to 3500 nanometers, on a common linear scale in megawatts per square meter per micrometer. The 6000 K, 4000 K, and 3000 K peaks are at approximately 483, 724, and 966 nanometers. A shaded band marks approximately 380 to 750 nanometers as visible light. Hotter blackbodies have a higher peak and a shorter peak wavelength.
